mentors.name: Aman Kumar
mentors.bio: With a passion for making physics intuitive and exciting, Aman founded BiharWaleSirji to bring a new, relatable teaching style to students across India. His mission is to build a 'Parivaar' where every student feels supported and empowered to achieve their dreams.
mentors.philosophy: Teach with the heart of an elder brother, not a stranger.

mentors.name: Dr. Priya Singh
mentors.bio: Dr. Singh brings her extensive knowledge and experience from the medical field into the classroom. She excels at breaking down complex biological and chemical processes into easy-to-understand concepts, preparing students for NEET and other competitive exams with a deep conceptual foundation.
mentors.philosophy: Understanding the 'why' is more important than memorizing the 'what'.

mentors.name: Rajesh Mahto
mentors.bio: A mathematics wizard, Rajesh believes that anyone can excel at math with the right guidance. He specializes in shortcuts, mental math techniques, and logical reasoning, making him a favorite among students preparing for competitive exams that require speed and accuracy.
mentors.philosophy: There is always a shorter, smarter way to solve a problem.
